A small sound bridge also links the warning act to its object, as the nūn opening of the verb is answered by the following fire noun before the harsher blaze-word arrives.

words.prose: {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}) is not another warned group but the content of the warning: an accusative, concrete fire placed after the addressed recipients. Its indefiniteness introduces a fresh, unbounded threat; the familiar fire-field arrives as "a fire" before 92:15 picks it up and restricts exposure to it. The {{ar:ن و ر}} ({{tr:n-w-r}}) family supports both fire and light, so the local noun selects burning fire while retaining visible luminosity as destructive radiance, not guidance-light such as the 24:35 comparison. Because that visible fire is the warning content, it also carries a narrowed signal-fire payoff, and the following blaze makes the image material contact heat rather than an abstract punishment label. Structurally, the word is named first and then intensified by {{ar:تَلَظَّىٰ}} ({{tr:talaẓẓā}}), turning the prior claim about the hereafter into a sensory object that then blazes. In sound, the open ā and brief tanwīn release of the fire noun feed into the long final ā and heavier texture of the blaze-word.

words.prose: {{ar:تَلَظَّىٰ}} ({{tr:talaẓẓā}}) is the ayah's landing point: a perfect 3fs verb whose hidden subject is the fire. Agreement and attachment keep it from becoming a new main event or an action of the audience; it modifies {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}) as a fire already characterized by blazing. Its Form V shape gives the blaze self-involving force, so the fire is not merely kindled from outside but presented as flaring of itself. A reported imperfect variant would make the blaze feel ongoing, but the standard perfect frames it as an already established property of the fire. The rare {{ar:ل ظ ي}} ({{tr:l-ẓ-y}}) root also points toward {{ar:لَظَىٰ}} ({{tr:laẓā}}) as a Hell-name in 70:15, while the local word remains a verb; within the supplied occurrence evidence, this exact Form V verbal surface is singular against that related noun. Sound and closure reinforce the same effect: doubled emphatic pressure and the final open vowel make the warning end on self-intensifying blaze, which 92:15 then turns into exposure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative warning أَنذَرْ governs the direct object نَارًا, whose following verb تَلَظَّىٰ makes the danger active rather than inert.
baseline_models.mechanism: A speech act discloses a feared object in order to awaken caution; the object is burning fire intensified as a self-flaring, pure blaze.

activation_trace.role: Warning that awakens fear and caution supplies both the speech act and its intended vigilance.
Burning, flickering fire supplies the concrete danger announced by the warning.
Pure flame flaring and kindling turns the warned-of object into an ongoing event.

changed_reading.before: A bare declaration that there is a fire.
changed_reading.after: An alarm deliberately makes an actively intensifying blaze present to the hearers so that caution can begin before contact.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَارًا is both the warned-of object and, through its branch inventory, something sighted from afar or functioning as a visible landmark.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verbal warning and the visible fire duplicate one another as distance-crossing signals: speech lets the addressees see in advance what the blazing landmark would otherwise reveal only on approach.

activation_trace.role: The warning carries knowledge of danger across distance before the hearers reach it.
Sighting fire from afar supplies the anticipatory visual geometry of the warning.
A conspicuous beacon or boundary marker makes the fire a negative landmark.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burning/branding, giving, wealth, growth, and purification; I supply the analogy that these are rival transformative regimes and the arrow from released wealth to a changed giver. changed_reading.before: The blaze is only an externally imposed physical punishment.
changed_reading.after: The blaze becomes one mode of transformation set against another: consuming and marking heat versus giving that purifies and grows the giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: Focus branches activate warning as binding liability or wound-compensation and fire as a brand. activation_trace.role: Binding oneself to an otherwise non-obligatory undertaking supplies an obligation register.

Exhaustive negation removes every human creditor from the motive structure.
Benefit and good condition supply the favor that could otherwise create reciprocal debt.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the ordinary reciprocal ledger being negated.
Collecting and fully satisfying a debt sharpens the settlement mechanism.

Sovereignty and ownership relocate the ultimate claim beyond interpersonal exchange.

structural_cues: 92:19 negates a favor being recompensed; 92:20 replaces that motive through an إِلَّا exception.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligation, compensation, branding, favor, recompense, debt collection, seeking, and sovereignty; I connect them into a legal-economic notice whose settlement exceeds human reciprocity. A live alternative is that 92:19-20 only purifies motive and never activates a liability metaphor in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The warning announces heat with no exchange structure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also sounds like notice of an account that no human favor, repayment, or ordinary compensation can discharge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeking, face/direction, sovereignty, and above form an upward intentional vector. The focus fire-beacon becomes its negative counterpart: the warning gives one bearing to avoid while the later phrase gives the bearing actively sought.

activation_trace.role: The warning communicates a negative bearing early enough for reorientation.
A beacon or boundary marker makes the fire the visible direction not to follow.
The active blaze keeps the negative landmark dynamically salient.
Active seeking supplies intentional movement toward the opposed goal.

structural_cues: 92:20 packs seeking, face, lordship, and superlative height into one motive phrase.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeking, direction, sovereignty, upper location, and a focus beacon; I polarize them as opposed bearings, one avoided and one sought. An alternative is that أَعْلَىٰ denotes rank alone, so no vertical geometry should be projected back onto the fire.

changed_reading.after: It is one pole in an orientational field: warning marks the bearing to refuse, while seeking the highest face supplies the positive bearing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing satisfaction stands opposite the focus branches of flaring enmity and burning anger. This does not identify one subject for both states; it activates an affective spectrum in which blazing hostility and settled acceptance are rival terminal climates.

activation_trace.role: Enmity flaring among people supplies the social heat at one end of the spectrum.

structural_cues: تَلَظَّىٰ and يَرْضَىٰ are late, intransitive verbal closures with matching final ā cadence.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies anger, social enmity, and satisfaction branches plus a formal terminal echo; I infer an affective counterpoint but do not transfer grammatical agency from one verb to the other. A live alternative is that the two states belong to entirely separate semantic domains and only the rhyme links them.

changed_reading.before: The personified blaze is an isolated image of anger.
changed_reading.after: The closing satisfaction gives that heat a coexisting affective opposite: the sequence can move from flaring antagonism toward settled acceptance without making them the same agent's emotion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from ه د ي to a form-distant threat branch. surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because wound compensation and livestock branding are not the surface senses of the focus words. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same focus construction joins a warning root with a compensation branch to a fire root with a branding branch, then intensifies the fire through تَلَظَّىٰ.

changed_reading.before: The ayah announces an unstructured physical danger.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it resembles formal notice of a liability whose fiery sanction leaves a visible mark.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain image is surprising because it activates the fire root's blossom branch and a non-dominant growth branch under ر ب ب. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَارًا carries a branch of tree bloom while تَلَظَّىٰ gives that bloom a violently flaring form.

activation_trace.role: Tree blossom and bloom supply the shape of an unfolding, outward-opening fire.

changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the fire can 'flower' into destructive visibility, opposed by the nourished growth activated through giving and purification.

strongest_changes: The night/day and guidance cues strengthen a negative-beacon reading: warning unveils and maps delayed danger rather than merely threatening it.
The mirrored ease/difficulty sequences revise the warning into an intervention inside a feedback fork, before a chosen route becomes easy to continue.
The post-focus restriction, turning, separation, and protection produce a selective contact geometry: everyone is warned, but orientation determines proximity to the blaze.
Giving, purification, non-repayment, and seeking preserve additional transformative and ledger-like readings alongside the direct punitive one.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's three inventories are unusually generative together: warning can awaken caution or activate liability; fire can be blaze, beacon, recoil, hostility, brand, or bloom; and تَلَظَّىٰ makes the object active while also admitting an anger image. Context did not settle these into one sense. It organized them into coexisting perceptual, path-dependent, spatial, legal-economic, material, and affective models, with the split ه د ي inventory adding a carefully contained threat-inside-guidance echo.
remaining_uncertainties: The fall-to-flame geometry is coherent but its directional convergence is reader-supplied rather than stated.
The liability/brand and destructive-bloom readings are packet-backed activations, not secure surface glosses.
The anger-to-satisfaction counterpoint must keep agency unresolved; the packet does not make both verbs one subject's emotion.
The force of فَ in 92:14 may tightly bind warning to guidance and temporal ownership, or may mark a looser discourse consequence.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Warning as fear that awakens caution.** Evidence: `ن ذ ر` B001 (warning that awakens fear/caution), `ن و ر` B002 (burning fire), `ل ظ ي` B001 (pure blazing flame). Structural cue: warning follows guidance and ownership. Mechanism: the warning operationalizes guidance for those nearing harm. Abductive move: I infer that fear is medicinal when it produces وقاية. Reading change: the fire is not introduced as spectacle; it is an alarm designed to make caution possible.

2. **Fire as illumination and boundary-marker.** Evidence: `ن و ر` B001 (light/illumination), B005 (beacon/landmark), activated by 92:2 daylight and 92:12 guidance. Structural cue: the same field can illuminate or burn. Mechanism: fire marks the dangerous edge of the wrong path. Abductive move: I infer a double function: punishment-fire also reveals route boundaries. Reading change: the blaze becomes a negative lighthouse.

3. **Blazing as anger and social flare.** Evidence: `ل ظ ي` B003 (burning with anger), `ن و ر` B007 (enmity flaring), activated by 92:16 denial and turning away. Structural cue: the fire is attached to a social-moral type, not only a place. Mechanism: refused truth ignites hostility that later receives fiery form. Abductive move: I infer that eschatological flame externalizes an already-kindled antagonism. Reading change: تَلَظَّىٰ can expose the inner heat of denial.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 92:19’s “no one has a favor with him” made the scatteredness social as well as moral: people are dispersed into creditor/debtor networks unless purified giving exits that network. 92:13 also made the divergence temporal, with first and last held together by God.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Fire as a visible warning-beacon.** `أَنذَرْتُكُمْ` anchors `ن ذ ر:B001` (warning that awakens fear and caution); `نَارًا` anchors `ن و ر:B002` (burning fire) while activating `ن و ر:B001` (illumination) and `ن و ر:B005` (beacon or landmark). Guidance in 92:12 and the immediately specified encounter with fire in 92:15 turn illumination into advance orientation: the danger can be seen before it is met. The packet gives warning, light branches, and order; the inferred arrow is that the fire’s visibility makes caution possible. The ayah therefore presents fire not only as threatened harm but also as the sign that exposes where a course leads.

2. **A consequence already in active flare.** `تَلَظَّىٰ` anchors `ل ظ ي:B001` (pure flame flaring and blazing), while `ن و ر:B002` includes fire’s flickering movement. The verbal scene is followed by `يَصْلَىٰهَا` in 92:15 and by the behavioral description in 92:16, so warning, moving flame, encounter, and agent form a causal-looking chain. The chain’s direction from conduct to exposure is inferred; the packet directly supplies only sequence and relations. The fire reads as an active process toward which conduct is converging, not a static object placed at the end of the sentence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 92:15 converted the visible flame into an actual encounter, confirming the warning-beacon mechanism. 92:17 added the less obvious counterpart: because the danger remains blazing while one agent is placed aside from it, warning can be read as enabling a boundary relation rather than promising removal of the danger itself.

Bu ses yapısının incelenen köke dönmesi kaynakta kesinlik değil, yalnız olasılık olarak sunulur.
